Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely marked the task as complete and provided an incorrect conclusion that contradicts established ecology for algal bloom decay (which causes hypoxia leading to fish leaving and benthic die-offs). It incorrectly asserted dissolved oxygen would remain high, selected an outcome not matching the provided options (redefining “B”), and failed to engage any specialist as the task required.
